tool_input.command:
git show HEAD:apps/web/package-lock.json | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
pkgs = d.get('packages', {})
for name in ['node_modules/lucide-react','node_modules/next','node_modules/react','node_modules/next-auth']:
    p = pkgs.get(name)
    print(name, p.get('version') if p else None)
"
git show HEAD:apps/web/package-lock.json > /tmp/web-lock-old.json 2>&1; wc -l /tmp/web-lock-old.json; grep -n '"lucide-react"' /tmp/web-lock-old.json | head -20

for pkg in clsx lucide-react next next-auth react react-dom "@testing-library/react" "@types/node" "@types/react" "@types/react-dom" "@vitejs/plugin-react" autoprefixer eslint eslint-config-next jsdom postcss tailwindcss typescript vitest; do
  line=$(git show HEAD:apps/web/package-lock.json | grep -n "\"node_modules/$pkg\":" | head -1)
  if [ -n "$line" ]; then
    lineno=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f1)
    ver=$(git show HEAD:apps/web/package-lock.json | sed -n "${lineno},$((lineno+3))p" | grep '"version"' | head -1)
    echo "$pkg -> $ver"
  else
    echo "$pkg -> NOT FOUND"
  fi
done
